title: Telescope
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- tripod legs -->
  <polygon points='50,55 38,92 42,93 50,58' fill='#8B5E3C'/>
  <polygon points='50,55 62,92 58,93 50,58' fill='#A0704A'/>
  <polygon points='50,55 45,93 49,94 50,58' fill='#C08A5A'/>
  <!-- tripod head -->
  <rect x='44' y='50' width='12' height='8' rx='2' fill='#6B4423'/>
  <rect x='44' y='50' width='12' height='4' rx='2' fill='#8B5E3C'/>
  <!-- main tube body angled up-right -->
  <g transform='rotate(-30 50 40)'>
    <!-- barrel -->
    <rect x='28' y='32' width='44' height='14' rx='4' fill='#3A7BD5'/>
    <!-- lighter top highlight -->
    <rect x='28' y='32' width='44' height='5' rx='3' fill='#5D9EEF'/>
    <!-- front lens end -->
    <rect x='68' y='30' width='8' height='18' rx='3' fill='#2C5FA8'/>
    <!-- lens ring -->
    <rect x='68' y='30' width='4' height='18' rx='2' fill='#7EC8E3'/>
    <!-- eyepiece end -->
    <rect x='22' y='34' width='8' height='10' rx='2' fill='#2C5FA8'/>
    <rect x='18' y='35' width='6' height='8' rx='2' fill='#7EC8E3'/>
    <!-- decorative rings on barrel -->
    <rect x='40' y='32' width='3' height='14' rx='1' fill='#2C5FA8'/>
    <rect x='56' y='32' width='3' height='14' rx='1' fill='#2C5FA8'/>
  </g>
  <!-- small star target -->
  <g fill='#FFE066'>
    <polygon points='78,16 80,22 86,22 81,26 83,32 78,28 73,32 75,26 70,22 76,22'/>
  </g>
  <!-- little sparkle -->
  <g fill='#FFD700'>
    <circle cx='88' cy='35' r='1.5'/>
    <circle cx='66' cy='12' r='1'/>
  </g>
</svg>
